verdict.rationale: Notte documents remote/scalable browser sessions with programmatic control (start sessions via API, CDP/Playwright connection, live viewer URLs) which supports running multiple sessions programmatically, but there is no documented concurrency limit, quota, or explicit fleet-management API for running many sessions in parallel. Missing for 10: explicit documented concurrency limits/quotas, guidance on scaling to N parallel sessions, and independent verification of fleet-scale reliability.
